name: GitHub Changelog monitor
description: Open a labelled issue for every unreported GitHub Actions entry in the GitHub Changelog feed
inputs:
  token:
    description: Token used to read and open issues
    required: true
    default: ${{ github.token }}
  lookback-days:
    description: Only report entries published within this many days
    required: false
    default: "30"
  max-issues:
    description: Maximum number of issues opened per run
    required: false
    default: "10"
outputs:
  issues-created:
    description: Number of issues opened by this invocation
    value: ${{ steps.monitor.outputs.issues-created }}
  issue-urls:
    description: Newline-separated URLs of the issues opened by this invocation
    value: ${{ steps.monitor.outputs.issue-urls }}
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Install the changelog package
      shell: bash
      run: npm install --prefix "${RUNNER_TEMP}/actionlint-changelog" --no-save --package-lock=false --ignore-scripts @kjlint/changelog-rss@latest
    - name: Open issues for new Actions changelog entries

      uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9
      env: { LOOKBACK_DAYS: "${{ inputs.lookback-days }}", MAX_ISSUES: "${{ inputs.max-issues }}" }
      with:
        github-token: ${{ inputs.token }}
        retries: 3
        script: |
          const load = require('node:module').createRequire(`${process.env.RUNNER_TEMP}/actionlint-changelog/package.json`)
          const { default: run } = load('@kjlint/changelog-rss/action')
          await run({ github, context, core })

name: Build npm packages
description: Assemble the npm publish tree from a release's GoReleaser archives
inputs:
  version:
    description: Release version, with or without a leading v
    required: true
  repository:
    description: Repository to download the release archives from
    required: false
    default: ${{ github.repository }}
  token:
    description: Token used to download the release archives
    required: false
    default: ${{ github.token }}
  npm-dir:
    description: Directory holding targets.json and the facade sources
    required: false
    default: ${{ github.workspace }}/distribution/npm
  out-dir:
    description: Directory to write the publish tree into
    required: false
    default: ${{ github.workspace }}/distribution/npm/dist
  downloads:
    description: Directory of already-downloaded release archives; anything missing is fetched
    required: false
    default: ""
  only:
    description: Build a single target (e.g. linux-x64), or "facade"; empty builds everything
    required: false
    default: ""
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    # Self-contained module: runs from the action directory, and invisible to
    # ./... at the repository root because the go tool skips dot-directories.
    - name: Assemble packages
      shell: bash
      working-directory: ${{ github.action_path }}
      env:
        INPUT_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        INPUT_REPOSITORY: ${{ inputs.repository }}
        INPUT_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.token }}
        INPUT_NPM_DIR: ${{ inputs.npm-dir }}
        INPUT_OUT_DIR: ${{ inputs.out-dir }}
        INPUT_DOWNLOADS: ${{ inputs.downloads }}
        INPUT_ONLY: ${{ inputs.only }}
      run: go run .

name: Publish an npm tarball
description: Publish one packed tarball through npm trusted publishing and report where it landed
inputs:
  tarball:
    description: Path to the .tgz to publish
    required: true
  dist-tag:
    description: npm dist-tag to publish under
    required: true
  dry-run:
    description: Run the publish without sending anything to the registry
    required: false
    default: "false"
outputs:
  name:
    description: Published package name
    value: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.name }}
  version:
    description: Published version
    value: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.version }}
  url:
    description: Registry page for the published version
    value: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.url }}
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    # Name and version come from the tarball's own manifest; npm's --json output
    # is keyed by package name and has changed shape between majors.
    - name: Publish
      id: publish
      shell: bash
      env:
        TARBALL: ${{ inputs.tarball }}
        DIST_TAG: ${{ inputs.dist-tag }}
        DRY_RUN: ${{ inputs.dry-run }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        # A relative spec needs an explicit ./ prefix; npm reads a bare
        # `tarballs/x.tgz` as a GitHub shorthand and tries to clone it.
        case "${TARBALL}" in
        /* | ./* | ../*) spec="${TARBALL}" ;;
        *) spec="./${TARBALL}" ;;
        esac
        if [[ ! -f "${spec}" ]]; then
          echo "::error::no tarball at ${spec}"
          exit 1
        fi

        manifest="$(tar -xzOf "${spec}" package/package.json)"
        name="$(jq -er .name <<<"${manifest}")"
        version="$(jq -er .version <<<"${manifest}")"

        args=(--access public --tag "${DIST_TAG}")
        if [[ "${DRY_RUN}" == 'true' ]]; then
          # Allow testing existing releases; --dry-run still prevents uploads.
          args+=(--dry-run --force)
        fi
        npm publish "${spec}" "${args[@]}"

        {
          echo "name=${name}"
          echo "version=${version}"
          echo "url=https://npm.im/package/${name}/v/${version}"
        } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

name: Build PyPI wheels
description: Build the actionlint-kjanat wheels from release archives and run one of them in a virtual environment
inputs:
  version:
    description: Release version, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
    required: true
  assets-dir:
    description: Directory holding actionlint_<version>_checksums.txt and the release archives; empty skips the build
    required: false
    default: ""
  out-dir:
    description: Directory the wheels are written to, or already hold them when assets-dir is empty
    required: true
  smoke:
    description: Platform tag of the wheel to install and run, such as manylinux_2_17_x86_64 or win_amd64
    required: true
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Build the wheels
      if: inputs.assets-dir != ''
      shell: bash
      env:
        VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        ASSETS_DIR: ${{ inputs.assets-dir }}
        OUT_DIR: ${{ inputs.out-dir }}
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        npm ci --ignore-scripts
        node distribution/pypi/src/cli.ts build --version "${VERSION}" --assets "${ASSETS_DIR}" --out "${OUT_DIR}"
    - name: Install the ${{ inputs.smoke }} wheel and run actionlint -version
      shell: pwsh
      env:
        VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        OUT_DIR: ${{ inputs.out-dir }}
        SMOKE: ${{ inputs.smoke }}
      run: |
        $venv = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP pypi-smoke-venv
        $python = $IsWindows ? 'python' : 'python3'
        & $python -m venv --clear $venv
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
        $bin = Join-Path $venv ($IsWindows ? 'Scripts' : 'bin')
        $exe = $IsWindows ? '.exe' : ''
        $wheel = Join-Path $env:OUT_DIR "actionlint_kjanat-$env:VERSION-py3-none-$env:SMOKE.whl"
        & (Join-Path $bin "python$exe") -m pip install --no-index --no-deps $wheel
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
        $version = @(& (Join-Path $bin "actionlint$exe") -version)
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
        $version
        if (-not $version[0].EndsWith(" $env:VERSION")) {
          Write-Output "::error::actionlint -version from $wheel reported '$($version[0])', expected it to end with $env:VERSION"
          exit 1
        }

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
: "${GITHUB_ACTION_PATH:?}" "${RUNNER_TEMP:?}"
[[ "${RUNNER_OS:-}" == Linux && "${RUNNER_ARCH:-}" == X64 ]] || {
	echo 'Pinned formatters require Linux/X64' >&2
	exit 1
}
pins="${GITHUB_ACTION_PATH}/pins.tsv"
identity="$(sha256sum "${pins}")"
identity="${identity%% *}"
cache_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/formatter-cache/${identity}"
bin_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/formatter-bin/${identity}"

case "${1:-}" in
	prepare)
		: "${GITHUB_OUTPUT:?}"
		printf 'cache-dir=%s\ncache-key=formatters-linux-x64-v1-%s\n' "${cache_dir}" "${identity}" >>"${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
		;;
	install)
		: "${GITHUB_PATH:?}"
		mkdir -p "${cache_dir}" "${bin_dir}"
		staging="$(mktemp -d "${RUNNER_TEMP}/formatters.XXXXXX")"
		trap 'rm -rf -- "${staging}"' EXIT
		while IFS=$'\t' read -r name version repo tag asset digest member; do
			[[ "${digest}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || {
				echo 'Invalid formatter SHA-256 pin' >&2
				exit 1
			}
			archive="${cache_dir}/${asset}"
			if [[ ! -f "${archive}" ]]; then
				curl --fail --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' \
					"https://github.com/${repo}/releases/download/${tag}/${asset}" --output "${staging}/${asset}"
				printf '%s  %s\n' "${digest}" "${staging}/${asset}" | sha256sum --check --status
				mv "${staging}/${asset}" "${archive}"
			fi
			# Cached archives and existing executables are never trusted without verification.
			printf '%s  %s\n' "${digest}" "${archive}" | sha256sum --check --status
			case "${asset}" in
				*.zip) unzip -p "${archive}" "${member}" >"${staging}/${name}" ;;
				*.tar.gz) tar -xOzf "${archive}" "${member}" >"${staging}/${name}" ;;
				*)
					echo 'Unsupported formatter archive' >&2
					exit 1
					;;
			esac
			chmod +x "${staging}/${name}"
			"${staging}/${name}" --version | grep -F -- "${version}"
		done <"${pins}"
		for name in dprint tombi; do
			mv -f "${staging}/${name}" "${bin_dir}/${name}"
		done
		printf '%s\n' "${bin_dir}" >>"${GITHUB_PATH}"
		;;
	*)
		echo 'Expected prepare or install' >&2
		exit 1
		;;
esac

files..github/actions/setup-pandoc/setup.bash:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
: "${GITHUB_ACTION_PATH:?}" "${RUNNER_TEMP:?}"

version=3.11
arch="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"
case "${arch}" in
	amd64 | arm64) ;;
	*)
		printf 'Unsupported Pandoc architecture: %s\n' "${arch}" >&2
		exit 1
		;;
esac
asset="pandoc-${version}-1-${arch}.deb"
digest="$(awk -v asset="${asset}" '$2 == asset { print $1 }' "${GITHUB_ACTION_PATH}/SHA256SUMS")"
[[ "${digest}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || {
	echo 'Missing Pandoc SHA-256 pin' >&2
	exit 1
}
cache_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/pandoc-cache/${digest}"
archive="${cache_dir}/${asset}"

case "${1:-}" in
	prepare)
		: "${GITHUB_OUTPUT:?}"
		printf 'cache-dir=%s\ncache-key=pandoc-deb-v1-%s-%s\n' "${cache_dir}" "${arch}" "${digest}" >>"${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
		;;
	install)
		mkdir -p "${cache_dir}"
		trap 'rm -f -- "${archive}.tmp"' EXIT
		if [[ ! -f "${archive}" ]]; then
			# Public, immutable release bytes: no authenticated API discovery, even on a cold cache.
			curl --fail --location --retry 3 --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' \
				"https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/releases/download/${version}/${asset}" --output "${archive}.tmp"
			printf '%s  %s\n' "${digest}" "${archive}.tmp" | sha256sum --check --status
			mv "${archive}.tmp" "${archive}"
		fi
		# A cache hit is untrusted until its bytes match the reviewed pin, too.
		printf '%s  %s\n' "${digest}" "${archive}" | sha256sum --check --status
		sudo dpkg --install "${archive}"
		;;
	*)
		echo 'Expected prepare or install' >&2
		exit 1
		;;
esac

name: Setup cached runner cli
description: Install pinned runner bytes using bundled signed provenance and reuse authenticated binary hashes.
inputs:
  version-file:
    description: File containing an exact runner version pin.
    default: .tool-versions
  verify:
    description: Provenance policy, auto or require. Reviewed pins always have verified provenance.
    default: auto
outputs:
  version:
    description: Installed runner version.
    value: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.version }}
  bin-dir:
    description: Directory added to PATH.
    value: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.bin-dir }}
  runner-bin:
    description: Full path to runner.
    value: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.runner-bin }}
  run-bin:
    description: Full path to run.
    value: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.run-bin }}
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Identify pinned runner installation
      id: prepare
      shell: bash
      env:
        VERSION_FILE: ${{ inputs.version-file }}
        VERIFY_MODE: ${{ inputs.verify }}
      run: node "${GITHUB_ACTION_PATH//\\//}/setup.mjs" prepare
    - name: Restore runner installation
      uses: actions/cache/restore@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
      with:
        path: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.cache-dir }}
        key: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.cache-key }}
    - name: Check runner verification receipt
      id: inspect
      shell: bash
      env:
        VERSION_FILE: ${{ inputs.version-file }}
        VERIFY_MODE: ${{ inputs.verify }}
      run: node "${GITHUB_ACTION_PATH//\\//}/setup.mjs" inspect
    - name: Install and verify runner
      id: install
      if: steps.inspect.outputs.hit != 'true'
      shell: bash
      env:
        VERSION_FILE: ${{ inputs.version-file }}
        VERIFY_MODE: ${{ inputs.verify }}
      run: node "${GITHUB_ACTION_PATH//\\//}/setup.mjs" install
    - name: Save verified runner installation
      if: steps.inspect.outputs.hit != 'true'
      uses: actions/cache/save@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
      with:
        path: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.cache-dir }}
        key: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.cache-key }}
    - name: Publish runner paths
      id: publish
      shell: bash
      env:
        VERSION_FILE: ${{ inputs.version-file }}
        VERIFY_MODE: ${{ inputs.verify }}
      run: node "${GITHUB_ACTION_PATH//\\//}/setup.mjs" publish

#!/usr/bin/env bash

retry() {
	local attempt status delay=2
	for attempt in 1 2 3 4; do
		if "$@"; then
			return 0
		else
			status=$?
		fi
		if ((attempt == 4)); then
			return "${status}"
		fi
		printf 'GitHub release request failed (exit %s); retrying in %ss (attempt %s/4).\n' "${status}" "${delay}" "$((attempt + 1))" >&2
		sleep "${delay}"
		delay=$((delay * 2))
	done
}

# Dynamic versions need metadata. Honor GitHub's quota headers before retrying;
# fail when the requested wait exceeds the bounded retry window.
github_api() {
	local response status http retry_after reset remaining delay attempt
	for attempt in 1 2 3; do
		response="$(mktemp)"
		if gh api --include "$1" >"${response}"; then
			awk 'body {print} /^\r?$/ {body=1}' "${response}"
			rm -f "${response}"
			return 0
		else
			status=$?
		fi
		http="$(awk 'NR == 1 {print $2}' "${response}")"
		retry_after="$(awk 'tolower($1) == "retry-after:" {gsub("\r", "", $2); print $2}' "${response}")"
		reset="$(awk 'tolower($1) == "x-ratelimit-reset:" {gsub("\r", "", $2); print $2}' "${response}")"
		remaining="$(awk 'tolower($1) == "x-ratelimit-remaining:" {gsub("\r", "", $2); print $2}' "${response}")"
		rm -f "${response}"
		if [[ "${http}" != 403 && "${http}" != 429 ]] || ((attempt == 3)); then return "${status}"; fi
		delay=$((60 * attempt))
		if [[ "${retry_after}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then delay=${retry_after}; fi
		if [[ "${remaining}" == 0 && "${reset}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
			reset=$((reset - $(date +%s) + 1))
			if ((reset > delay)); then delay=${reset}; fi
		fi
		if ((delay > 300)); then
			printf 'GitHub API quota requires waiting %ss; retry after the reset or use a reviewed pinned version.\n' "${delay}" >&2
			return "${status}"
		fi
		printf 'GitHub API rate limited; waiting %ss before retry.\n' "${delay}" >&2
		sleep "${delay}"
	done
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

action_path=${GITHUB_ACTION_PATH:?}
runner_os=${RUNNER_OS:?}
runner_arch=${RUNNER_ARCH:?}
runner_temp=${RUNNER_TEMP:?}
update_path=${UPDATE_PATH:?}
gh_repo=${GH_REPO:?}
github_output=${GITHUB_OUTPUT:?}
github_path=${GITHUB_PATH:?}
version=${VERSION-}
tag=${TAG-}
cache_dir=${CACHE_DIR-}
release_file=${RELEASE_FILE-}

source "${action_path//\\//}/retry.bash"

case "${runner_os}/${runner_arch}" in
	Linux/X64) platform=linux.x86_64 ;;
	Linux/ARM64) platform=linux.aarch64 ;;
	macOS/X64) platform=darwin.x86_64 ;;
	macOS/ARM64) platform=darwin.aarch64 ;;
	# The Windows release uses x64 emulation on ARM64 runners.
	Windows/X64 | Windows/ARM64) platform=windows ;;
	*)
		echo '::error::Unsupported runner platform.'
		exit 1
		;;
esac
case "${update_path}" in
	true | false) ;;
	*)
		echo '::error::update-path must be true or false.'
		exit 1
		;;
esac

prepare() {
	local tag release_file
	release_file="$(mktemp "${runner_temp//\\//}/shellcheck-release.XXXXXXXX")"
	if [[ "${version}" == latest ]]; then
		github_api "repos/${gh_repo}/releases/latest" >"${release_file}"
		tag="$(jq -r '.tag_name' "${release_file}")"
	elif [[ "${version}" =~ ^v?[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
		tag="v${version#v}"
	else
		echo '::error::shellcheck-version must be a release version or latest.'
		exit 1
	fi
	if [[ ! "${tag}" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
		echo '::error::The release does not have a stable ShellCheck version tag.'
		exit 1
	fi
	if jq -e --arg repo "${gh_repo}" --arg tag "${tag}" '.repository == $repo and .tag_name == $tag' "${action_path}/pinned-release.json" >/dev/null; then
		cp "${action_path}/pinned-release.json" "${release_file}"
	elif [[ ! -s "${release_file}" ]]; then
		github_api "repos/${gh_repo}/releases/tags/${tag}" >"${release_file}"
	fi
	printf 'tag=%s\nrelease-file=%s\ncache-dir=%s/actionlint-shellcheck/%s/%s\n' \
		"${tag}" "${release_file}" "${runner_temp//\\//}" "${tag}" "${platform}" >>"${github_output}"
}

checksum=(sha256sum)
if [[ "${runner_os}" == macOS ]]; then checksum=(shasum -a 256); fi

verified_archive() {
	local expected=$1 digest actual
	cache_valid=false
	if [[ -f "${cache_dir}/archive" && -f "${cache_dir}/sha256" ]]; then
		digest="$(cat "${cache_dir}/sha256")"
		if [[ "${digest}" == "${expected}" ]]; then
			actual="$("${checksum[@]}" "${cache_dir}/archive")"
			if [[ "${actual%% *}" == "${digest}" ]]; then cache_valid=true; fi
		fi
	fi
}

install_shellcheck() {
	local release release_tag metadata asset digest archive actual install_dir binary=shellcheck
	local -a assets=("shellcheck-${tag}.${platform}.tar.gz" "shellcheck-${tag}.${platform}.tar.xz")
	if [[ "${platform}" == windows ]]; then
		assets=("shellcheck-${tag}.zip")
		binary=shellcheck.exe
	fi
	release="$(cat "${release_file}")"
	release_tag="$(jq -r '.tag_name' <<<"${release}")"
	if [[ "${release_tag}" != "${tag}" ]]; then
		echo '::error::The release does not match the requested ShellCheck version.'
		exit 1
	fi
	for asset in "${assets[@]}"; do
		metadata="$(jq -c --arg name "${asset}" '.assets[] | select(.name == $name)' <<<"${release}")"
		if [[ -n "${metadata}" ]]; then break; fi
	done
	if [[ -z "${metadata}" ]]; then
		echo "::error::No ShellCheck release asset is available for ${platform} in ${tag}."
		exit 1
	fi
	digest="$(jq -r '.digest' <<<"${metadata}")"
	if [[ ! "${digest}" =~ ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
		echo "::error::The release asset ${asset} is missing a valid SHA-256 checksum."
		exit 1
	fi
	verified_archive "${digest#sha256:}"
	if [[ "${cache_valid}" == false ]]; then
		if [[ -e "${cache_dir}/archive" || -e "${cache_dir}/sha256" ]]; then
			echo '::warning::Discarding corrupt ShellCheck cache; downloading a verified archive.'
		fi
		archive="$(mktemp "${runner_temp//\\//}/shellcheck-archive.XXXXXXXX")"
		# This is a public release: avoid gh release download's second metadata request.
		retry curl --fail --location --silent --show-error --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --output "${archive}" \
			"https://github.com/${gh_repo}/releases/download/${tag}/${asset}"
		actual="$("${checksum[@]}" "${archive}")"
		if [[ "${actual%% *}" != "${digest#sha256:}" ]]; then
			rm -f "${archive}"
			echo '::error::The ShellCheck download does not match its SHA-256 checksum.'
			exit 1
		fi
		mkdir -p "${cache_dir}"
		mv "${archive}" "${cache_dir}/archive"
		printf '%s\n' "${digest#sha256:}" >"${cache_dir}/sha256"
	fi
	install_dir="$(mktemp -d "${runner_temp//\\//}/shellcheck.XXXXXXXX")"
	if [[ "${platform}" == windows ]]; then
		unzip -p "${cache_dir}/archive" shellcheck.exe >"${install_dir}/${binary}"
		install_dir="$(cygpath -m "${install_dir}")"
	else
		tar -xf "${cache_dir}/archive" -C "${install_dir}" --strip-components=1 "shellcheck-${tag}/shellcheck"
	fi
	"${install_dir}/${binary}" --version
	printf 'shellcheck-path=%s/%s\n' "${install_dir}" "${binary}" >>"${github_output}"
	if [[ "${update_path}" == true ]]; then
		printf '%s\n' "${install_dir}" >>"${github_path}"
	fi
	rm -f "${release_file}"
}

case "$1" in
	prepare) prepare ;;
	install) install_shellcheck ;;
	*)
		echo '::error::Unknown ShellCheck setup phase.'
		exit 1
		;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
: "${GITHUB_ACTION_PATH:?}" "${RUNNER_TEMP:?}" "${RUNNER_OS:?}" "${RUNNER_ARCH:?}"

if [[ "${RUNNER_OS}/${RUNNER_ARCH}" != Linux/X64 ]]; then
	echo 'The plugin fixture toolchain requires Linux/X64.' >&2
	exit 1
fi
pins="${GITHUB_ACTION_PATH}/releases.json"
jq -e 'type == "array" and length == 2 and ([.[].name] | sort == ["wasm-tools", "wit-bindgen"]) and all(.[]; (.version | test("^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$")) and (.sha256 | test("^[a-f0-9]{64}$")))' "${pins}" >/dev/null
identity="$(sha256sum "${pins}")"
cache_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/wasm-toolchain/${identity%% *}"

case "${1:-}" in
	prepare)
		: "${GITHUB_OUTPUT:?}"
		printf 'cache-dir=%s\ncache-key=wasm-toolchain-v1-linux-x64-%s\n' "${cache_dir}" "${identity%% *}" >>"${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
		;;
	install)
		: "${GITHUB_PATH:?}"
		mkdir -p "${cache_dir}"
		install_dir="$(mktemp -d "${RUNNER_TEMP}/wasm-tools.XXXXXXXX")"
		releases="$(jq -r '.[] | [.name, .version, .sha256] | @tsv' "${pins}" | tr -d '\r')"
		while IFS=$'\t' read -r name version digest; do
			base="${name}-${version}-x86_64-linux"
			archive="${cache_dir}/${digest}.tar.gz"
			trap 'rm -f -- "${archive}.tmp"' EXIT
			if ! printf '%s  %s\n' "${digest}" "${archive}" | sha256sum --check --status 2>/dev/null; then
				curl --fail --location --silent --show-error --retry 3 --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' \
					"https://github.com/bytecodealliance/${name}/releases/download/v${version}/${base}.tar.gz" --output "${archive}.tmp"
				printf '%s  %s\n' "${digest}" "${archive}.tmp" | sha256sum --check --status
				mv "${archive}.tmp" "${archive}"
			fi
			tar -xzf "${archive}" -C "${install_dir}" --strip-components=1 "${base}/${name}"
			"${install_dir}/${name}" --version
		done <<<"${releases}"
		printf '%s\n' "${install_dir}" >>"${GITHUB_PATH}"
		;;
	*)
		echo 'Expected prepare or install' >&2
		exit 1
		;;
esac

        run: bash tools/ci/autofix-step.bash go run ./internal/documentation/check-readme -fix ./README.md
        env: { GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}" }
      - name: format the code
        id: format
        # autofix-ci will fail if the .github directory is touched
        run: bash tools/ci/autofix-step.bash dprint fmt --allow-no-files --diff --excludes .github
      - name: Describe applied fixes
        id: fixes
        env:
          MODERNIZE_CHANGED: ${{ steps.modernize.outputs.changed }}
          SCHEMA_CHANGED: ${{ steps.schema.outputs.changed }}
          TABLES_CHANGED: ${{ steps.tables.outputs.changed }}
          README_CHANGED: ${{ steps.readme.outputs.changed }}
          FORMAT_CHANGED: ${{ steps.format.outputs.changed }}
        run: |
          changes=()
          if [[ "${MODERNIZE_CHANGED}" == true ]]; then changes+=('modernize Go'); fi
          if [[ "${SCHEMA_CHANGED}" == true ]]; then changes+=('regenerate configuration schema'); fi
          if [[ "${TABLES_CHANGED}" == true ]]; then changes+=('regenerate Go tables'); fi
          if [[ "${README_CHANGED}" == true ]]; then changes+=('refresh README demo'); fi
          if [[ "${FORMAT_CHANGED}" == true ]]; then changes+=('format code'); fi
          if (( ${#changes[@]} )); then
            printf -v description '%s, ' "${changes[@]}"
            printf 'description=%s\n' "${description%, }" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          fi
      - name: Check fixes for stacked pull requests
        if: github.event.pull_request.stack != null
        run: git -c core.fileMode=false add --all;
          git diff --cached --exit-code
      - uses: autofix-ci/action@c5b2d67aa2274e7b5a18224e8171550871fc7e4a # v1
        if: github.event.pull_request.stack == null && steps.fixes.outputs.description != ''
        with:
          comment: "Applied fixes: ${{ steps.fixes.outputs.description }}. Please review the generated commit."
          commit-message: "chore: ${{ steps.fixes.outputs.description }}"
          fail-fast: true # ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

    needs: changes

    strategy:

      matrix: { os: [ubuntu-26.04, ubuntu-26.04-arm, macos-latest, macos-26-intel, windows-2025-vs2026, windows-11-vs2026-arm] }
    # Keep every required platform check present without allocating its native runner when unselected.
    runs-on: ${{ (needs.changes.result != 'success' || fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.jobs)['unit']) && matrix.os || 'ubuntu-slim' }}
    env: { CI_UNIT: "${{ needs.changes.result != 'success' || fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.jobs)['unit'] }}" }
    steps:
      - uses: &ActionsCheckout actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        if: env.CI_UNIT == 'true'
        with: &NoCreds { persist-credentials: false }
      # Parallel setup steps race while the runner rewrites event.json on Windows.
      - uses: &SetupGo actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7
        if: env.CI_UNIT == 'true'
        with: &GoMod { go-version-file: go.mod }
      - uses: &SetupUv astral-sh/setup-uv@07a047e608db84b3d8c06cd9a7c7dcc9c355c18e # v10.3.2
        if: env.CI_UNIT == 'true'
        with: &NoCache { enable-cache: false }
      - &PrepareMiseCache
        name: Keep mise metadata with cached tools
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mise_dir="${HOME//\\//}/.local/share/actionlint-mise"
          if [[ "${RUNNER_OS}" == Windows ]]; then mise_dir="$(cygpath -m "${mise_dir}")"; fi
          printf 'ACTIONLINT_MISE_DIR=%s\nMISE_CACHE_DIR=%s/cache\n' "${mise_dir}" "${mise_dir}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
      - name: Install the project Node.js and npm versions
        if: env.CI_UNIT == 'true'
        uses: &SetupMise jdx/mise-action@82a612c5ab8bcda7cc5db6b7e81a8e7584c3dc6e # v5.2.3
        with: &NodeTools
          cache: true
          auto_update: true
          mise_dir: ${{ env.ACTIONLINT_MISE_DIR }}
          cache_save_post: true
          cache_key: &MiseCacheKey >-
            actionlint-mise-v3-{{platform}}-{{version}}-{{mise_env}}-{{install_args_hash}}-p{{cache_period}}-${{ hashFiles('.mise.toml', '.tool-versions', '**/mise.lock', '**/.mise.lock') }}
          install_args: node npm
          add_shims_to_path: false
        env: &NodeToolsEnv { MISE_ENABLE_TOOLS: "node,npm" }
      - name: Install ShellCheck
        if: env.CI_UNIT == 'true'
        uses: $/.github/actions/setup-shellcheck
      - name: Install Ruff for integration tests
        if: env.CI_UNIT == 'true'
        run: uv tool install ruff==0.17.0
      - name: Install shells for completion tests on Linux
        if: ${{ env.CI_UNIT == 'true' && runner.os == 'Linux' }}
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends zsh fish bash-completion
          zsh --version; fish --version
      - name: Install the YAML language server for editor completion tests
        if: env.CI_UNIT == 'true'
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - if: env.CI_UNIT == 'true'
        run: go test -v ./...
      # Check build without CGO
      - if: env.CI_UNIT == 'true'
        run: go build ./cmd/actionlint
        env: { CGO_ENABLED: 0 }
  race:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (needs.changes.result != 'success' || fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.jobs)['race']) }}
    name: Race detector and coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: { contents: read, id-token: write }
    steps:
      - &ActCheckNocred { uses: *ActionsCheckout, with: *NoCreds }
      - &GoGomod { uses: *SetupGo, with: *GoMod }
      - &InstallShellCheck { name: Install ShellCheck, uses: $/.github/actions/setup-shellcheck }
      - &Uv { uses: *SetupUv, with: *NoCache }
      - *PrepareMiseCache
      - { name: Install the project Node.js and npm versions, uses: *SetupMise, with: *NodeTools, env: *NodeToolsEnv }
      - { name: Install Ruff for integration tests, run: uv tool install ruff==0.17.0 }
      - { name: Install the YAML language server for editor completion tests, run: npm ci --ignore-scripts }

      - run: go test -v -race -coverpkg=./... -coverprofile coverage.txt -covermode=atomic ./...
      - run: go tool cover -func ./coverage.txt

      # Set -race for catching data races on dog fooding (#333)
      - run: go build -race ./cmd/actionlint

      - name: Dog fooding 🐶
        # actionlint passes --norc to shellcheck, ignoring .shellcheckrc.
        run: echo "::add-matcher::.github/actionlint-matcher.json"; ./actionlint -color --shellcheck='shellcheck -o all'

      - uses: codecov/codecov-action@303a32d7a59b442fa8d48b6a1cc6825c09c847a5 # v7.1.1
        with: { use_oidc: true }
  wasm:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (needs.changes.result != 'success' || fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.jobs)['wasm']) }}
    name: Wasm
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - *ActCheckNocred
      - *PrepareMiseCache
      - name: Install project tools
        uses: *SetupMise
        with:
          cache: true
          auto_update: true
          mise_dir: ${{ env.ACTIONLINT_MISE_DIR }}
          cache_save_post: true
          cache_key: *MiseCacheKey
          install_args: go node npm
          add_shims_to_path: false
        env: { MISE_ENABLE_TOOLS: "go,node,npm" }
      - name: Install runner
        uses: $/.github/actions/setup-runner
        with: { version-file: .tool-versions }
      - name: Install Pandoc
        uses: $/.github/actions/setup-pandoc
      - name: Install JavaScript dependencies
        run: runner install --pm npm --no-tools --frozen
      - name: Build command manual
        run: run make:man
      - name: Build and test playground
        run: run -s actionlint-playground:build actionlint-playground:test
      - name: Lint playground
        run: run actionlint-playground:lint
  javascript:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (needs.changes.result != 'success' || fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.jobs)['javascript']) }}
    name: JavaScript
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - *ActCheckNocred
      - *PrepareMiseCache
      - name: Install project tools
        uses: *SetupMise
        with:
          cache: true
          auto_update: true
          mise_dir: ${{ env.ACTIONLINT_MISE_DIR }}
          cache_save_post: true
          cache_key: *MiseCacheKey
          install_args: node npm
          add_shims_to_path: false
        env: { MISE_ENABLE_TOOLS: "node,npm" }
      - name: Install runner
        uses: $/.github/actions/setup-runner
        with: { version-file: .tool-versions }
      - name: Install dependencies and test JavaScript tooling
        env: { MISE_TASK_RUN_AUTO_INSTALL: "false" }
        run: runner install --pm npm --no-tools --frozen test:js lint:biome
  release-snapshot:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (needs.changes.result != 'success' || fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.jobs)['release']) }}
    name: Release snapshot
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: *ActionsCheckout
        with: { fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false }
      - *PrepareMiseCache
      - parallel:
          - &Go { uses: *SetupGo, with: *GoMod }
          - { name: Install Pandoc, uses: $/.github/actions/setup-pandoc }
          - &Runner { uses: $/.github/actions/setup-runner, with: { version-file: .tool-versions } }
          - name: Install syft for SBOM generation
            uses: anchore/sbom-action/download-syft@66cbf4bc1f1c0d2edc94016e65bc221b6bb0ad6c # v0.24.3
          - { name: Install the project Node.js and npm versions, uses: *SetupMise, with: *NodeTools, env: *NodeToolsEnv }
      - name: Build JavaScript Action release files outside the checkout
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts;
          tag="$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 --match 'v[0-9]*.[0-9]*.[0-9]*' --exclude '*-*')";
          node tools/release/build-action-release.mjs --out-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/actionlint-action" --version "${tag#v}"
      - run: run make:man/actionlint.1
      - uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@a4f02ab5355a589de60d917a659ce617ed19b3de # v7.3.0
        with: { version-file: .tool-versions, args: release --snapshot --clean }
      - name: Smoke-test the linux/amd64 snapshot binary
        run: ./dist/linux_linux_amd64_v1/actionlint -version
  action-modules:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (needs.changes.result != 'success' || fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.jobs)['modules']) }}
    name: Action modules
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - *ActCheckNocred
      - uses: *SetupGo
        with: { go-version: stable, check-latest: true }
      # Self-contained modules under a dot-directory, which the go tool skips
      # when expanding a ... pattern. Test each in place.
      - name: Test and vet each action module
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for mod in .github/actions/*/go.mod; do
            dir="$(dirname "${mod}")"
            echo "::group::${dir}"
            (cd "${dir}" && go vet ./... && go test ./...)
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done
  lint:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (needs.changes.result != 'success' || fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.jobs)['lint']) }}
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - *ActCheckNocred
      - *Go
      - parallel: [*Uv, *InstallShellCheck, *Runner]
      # Sibling actions can rewrite the event payload this action reads at startup.
      - name: Install golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@ba0d7d2ec06a0ea1cb5fa41b2e4a3ab91d21278a # v9.3.0
        with: { version-file: .tool-versions, install-only: true, problem-matchers: true }
      - run: go mod tidy -diff
      - name: Build through Makefile
        run: run make:build
        env: &SkipGoGen { SKIP_GO_GENERATE: "true" }
      - run: run -s make:lint make:lint-docs
        env: *SkipGoGen
      - name: Lint bash scripts
        run: shellcheck tools/ci/*.bash distribution/docker/*.bash tools/release/*.bash distribution/install/*.bash
  plugins:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (needs.changes.result != 'success' || fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.jobs)['plugins']) }}
    name: Component plugins
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - *ActCheckNocred
      - *PrepareMiseCache
      - parallel:
          - *Go
          - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-wasm-toolchain
          - name: Install TinyGo
            uses: *SetupMise
            with:
              cache: true
              auto_update: true
              mise_dir: ${{ env.ACTIONLINT_MISE_DIR }}
              cache_save_post: true
              cache_key: *MiseCacheKey
              install_args: tinygo
              add_shims_to_path: false
            env: { MISE_ENABLE_TOOLS: "tinygo" }
          - name: Install the pinned Rust toolchain and targets
            run: rustup toolchain install
          - name: Install wasi-sdk
            run: |
              curl --silent --show-error --location --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-34/wasi-sdk-34.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz
              tar -xzf "${RUNNER_TEMP}/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "${RUNNER_TEMP}"
              echo "WASI_SDK_PATH=${RUNNER_TEMP}/wasi-sdk-34.0-x86_64-linux" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
      - name: Cache Cargo dependencies and workspace builds
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry/
            ~/.cargo/git/
            target/
            tools/runner-host/target/
          key: cargo-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('rust-toolchain.toml', 'Cargo.lock', '**/Cargo.lock', 'Cargo.toml', '**/Cargo.toml') }}
          restore-keys: cargo-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - name: Check Rust plugins and fixtures on the native target
        run: make plugins-check-native
      - name: Verify the guest SDK package
        run: cargo package --locked -p actionlint-extension-api --all-features
      - name: Build the pinned Wasmtime runner host
        run: cargo build --locked --manifest-path tools/runner-host/Cargo.toml
      - name: Build the plugin fixtures from source
        run: make -B plugins
      - name: Verify generated plugin interfaces
        run: |
          go run -C tools/plugin-contract .
          git diff --exit-code -- ':(glob)internal/plugins/component/*.gen.go'
      - name: Load the Rust, C and TinyGo examples
        run: >-
          go run ./cmd/actionlint --no-config --shellcheck= --ruff=
          --plugin internal/plugins/component/testdata/plugins/pipe-to-shell.wasm
          --plugin internal/plugins/component/testdata/plugins/no-sudo.wasm
          --plugin internal/plugins/component/testdata/plugins/insecure-download.wasm
          testdata/ok/minimal.yaml
      - name: Test plugins including Wasmtime runner parity
        env:
          ACTIONLINT_RUNNER_HOST: ${{ github.workspace }}/tools/runner-host/target/debug/actionlint-runner-host
        run: |
          test -x "${ACTIONLINT_RUNNER_HOST}"
          go test -count=1 -v ./internal/plugins/component ./internal/plugins/core ./plugin
      - run: go test -count=1 -run "Plugin|Engine|ModuleKind" ./internal/localapp ./internal/integration/cli
  docker:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (needs.changes.result != 'success' || fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.jobs)['docker']) }}
    name: Dockerfile
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - *ActCheckNocred
      - name: Build image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@c3c9e263c25d99ce0380d002d59b67737d91b0dc # v7.4.0
        with: { load: true, push: false, tags: actionlint:test }
      - name: Check bundled Ruff
        run: bash distribution/docker/test-docker-ruff.bash actionlint:test
      - name: Check published Wasm plugins and offline cache
        run: bash distribution/docker/test-docker-plugins.bash actionlint:test
      - name: Test Docker image
        run: docker container run
          --mount type=bind,source="${PWD}",target=/w
          -- actionlint:test -color -verbose
      - name: Build Docker Action compatibility image
        run: docker build --target action -t actionlint:action-test .
      - name: Check Docker Action compatibility
        run: bash distribution/docker/test-docker-action.bash actionlint:action-test
      - parallel:
          - name: Lint Dockerfile with hadolint
            run: docker run --rm -i hadolint/hadolint hadolint --ignore DL3018 --strict-labels
              --require-label org.opencontainers.image.source:url
              --require-label org.opencontainers.image.licenses:spdx
              - < Dockerfile
          - name: Lint Dockerfile with droast
            uses: immanuwell/dockerfile-roast@1c87b2aa189338c24db4acde40864dae8994de8f # 1.7.0
  action:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (needs.changes.result != 'success' || fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.jobs)['action']) }}
    name: GitHub Action
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix: { os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest] }
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: *ActionsCheckout
        with: { fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false }
      - *PrepareMiseCache
      # Parallel setup steps race while the runner rewrites event.json on Windows.
      - *GoGomod
      - *Runner
      - { name: Install the project Node.js and npm versions, uses: *SetupMise, with: *NodeTools, env: *NodeToolsEnv }
      - name: Install native ShellCheck for explicit backend tests
        uses: $/.github/actions/setup-shellcheck
      - name: Install JavaScript Action build dependencies
        # Packaging also runs when JavaScript-only tests are not selected.
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Test the JavaScript runtime and release packaging
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && (needs.changes.result != 'success' || fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.jobs)['action-tests']) }}
        env: { MISE_TASK_RUN_AUTO_INSTALL: "false", MSYS_NO_PATHCONV: "1" }
        run: run -s actionlint-action:typecheck actionlint-action:test //tools/release:test //tools/toolchain:test //distribution/docker:test //tools/action:test
      - name: Validate the staged release configuration
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@a4f02ab5355a589de60d917a659ce617ed19b3de # v7.3.0
        with: { version-file: .tool-versions, args: check }
      - name: Validate release workflows with this checkout
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: go run ./cmd/actionlint --shellcheck='shellcheck -o all'
          .github/workflows/*.y*ml # **/action.y*ml
      - name: Prepare the ordinary binary and release action
        env:
          BINARY_SUFFIX: ${{ runner.os == 'Windows' && '.exe' || '' }}
          GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: Action release test
          GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: action-release-test@example.invalid
          GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: Action release test
          GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: action-release-test@example.invalid
        run: |
          npm ci --ignore-scripts
          binary="${RUNNER_TEMP}/actionlint-test${BINARY_SUFFIX}"
          go build -o "${binary}" ./cmd/actionlint
          echo "ACTIONLINT_ACTION_BINARY=${binary}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
          tag="$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 --match 'v[0-9]*.[0-9]*.[0-9]*' --exclude '*-*')"
          node tools/release/build-action-release.mjs --out-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/actionlint-action" --version "${tag#v}"
          parent="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          candidate="$(node tools/release/build-action-release.mjs --commit --out-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/actionlint-action" \
            --version "${tag#v}" --parent "${parent}")"
          mkdir .actionlint-action-test
          git archive "${candidate}" | tar -x -C .actionlint-action-test
          test -f .actionlint-action-test/go.mod
          test -f .actionlint-action-test/cmd/actionlint/main.go
          (cd .actionlint-action-test && sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS)
      - name: Check Git-tag version fallback
        run: |
          env -u ACTIONLINT_VERSION run actionlint-action:build --out-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/actionlint-action-fallback"
          cmp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/actionlint-action-fallback/action.mjs" "${RUNNER_TEMP}/actionlint-action/action/action.mjs"
      - name: Install an explicit historical version
        id: setup-version
        uses: ./.actionlint-action-test
        env: { ACTIONLINT_ACTION_BINARY: "" }
        with:
          version: v1.17.0
          version-file: missing-actionlint-version
          install-only: true
          shellcheck: false
      - name: Check the installed version and prepare a version file
        run: |
          actionlint --version | grep -Fx 'actionlint.kjanat.dev 1.17.0'
          printf 'nodejs 24.0.0\nactionlint 1.17.0\n' > .actionlint-action-test/.tool-versions
      - name: Install from a tool version file
        id: setup-version-file
        uses: ./.actionlint-action-test
        env: { ACTIONLINT_ACTION_BINARY: "" }
        with:
          working-directory: .actionlint-action-test
          version-file: .tool-versions
          install-only: true
          shellcheck: false
      - name: Check setup outputs and the surviving binary
        env:
          VERSION_OUTPUTS: ${{ toJSON(steps.setup-version.outputs) }}
          VERSION_FILE_OUTPUTS: ${{ toJSON(steps.setup-version-file.outputs) }}
        run: |
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
          import { readdirSync } from 'node:fs';
          for (const value of [process.env.VERSION_OUTPUTS, process.env.VERSION_FILE_OUTPUTS]) {
            const outputs = JSON.parse(value);
            assert.equal(outputs.version, '1.17.0');
            assert.equal(outputs['exit-code'], '0');
            assert.equal(outputs.result, 'success');
            assert.equal(outputs['problem-count'], '');
            assert.equal(outputs['result-file'], '');
          }
          assert.ok(!readdirSync(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP).some(name => name.startsWith('actionlint-result-')));
          NODE
          actionlint_path="$(command -v actionlint)"
          [[ "${actionlint_path}" == */actionlint-bin-*/actionlint* ]]
          actionlint --version | grep -Fx 'actionlint.kjanat.dev 1.17.0'
          rm .actionlint-action-test/.tool-versions
      - name: Exercise the action through the real runner
        id: smoke
        # ./ loads the candidate release tree generated in this job's workspace.
        uses: ./.actionlint-action-test
        with: { files: testdata/ok/minimal.yaml, format: json, sarif: true }
      - name: Exercise inline configuration
        uses: ./.actionlint-action-test
        with:
          files: testdata/ok/minimal.yaml
          config: "config-variables: []"
          annotations: false
          summary: false
      - name: Exercise shared configuration
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p .github
          printf 'plugins: []\nconfig-variables: []\n' > .github/actionlint.yaml
      - name: Lint with shared configuration
        uses: ./.actionlint-action-test
        with:
          files: testdata/ok/minimal.yaml
          config-file: .github/actionlint.yaml
      - name: Exercise advisory review without a token
        uses: ./.actionlint-action-test
        with:
          files: testdata/err/one_error.yaml
          fail-on-error: false
          annotations: false
          review: true
          token: ""
      - name: Upload result files from the recipe
        if: always() && steps.smoke.outputs.result-file != ''
        uses: &UploadAction actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: actionlint-reports-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: |
            ${{ steps.smoke.outputs.result-file }}
            ${{ steps.smoke.outputs.report-sarif }}
      - name: Save Linux candidate for Dockerless runner
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: *UploadAction
        with:
          name: actionlint-linux-candidate
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/actionlint-action/action/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/actionlint-test
      - name: Check runner outputs and input compatibility
        env:
          EXIT_CODE: ${{ steps.smoke.outputs.exit-code }}
          RESULT: ${{ steps.smoke.outputs.result }}
          PROBLEM_COUNT: ${{ steps.smoke.outputs.problem-count }}
          OUTPUT: ${{ steps.smoke.outputs.output }}
        run: |
          node tools/action/check-action-outputs.mjs
          actionlint_path="$(command -v actionlint)"
          [[ "${actionlint_path}" == */actionlint-bin-*/actionlint* ]]
          actionlint -version
      - name: Verify bundled plugins and real cache restoration
        uses: ./.github/actions/test-action
        with:
          action-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/actionlint-action/action
          binary: ${{ env.ACTIONLINT_ACTION_BINARY }}
      - name: Check exported actionlint from PowerShell
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          actionlint -version
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          exit $LASTEXITCODE
  action-slim:
    name: GitHub Action (ubuntu-slim)
    needs: action
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - *ActCheckNocred
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with: { name: actionlint-linux-candidate, path: .actionlint-slim-test }
      - name: Restore executable permission
        run: chmod +x .actionlint-slim-test/actionlint-test
      - name: Lint on a Dockerless runner
        id: slim
        uses: ./.actionlint-slim-test/actionlint-action/action
        env: { ACTIONLINT_ACTION_BINARY: "${{ github.workspace }}/.actionlint-slim-test/actionlint-test" }
        with: { files: testdata/ok/minimal.yaml, shellcheck: false }
      - name: Verify Dockerless result
        env: { RESULT: "${{ steps.slim.outputs.result }}" }
        run: test "${RESULT}" = success
  action-result:
    name: GitHub Action
    needs: [action, action-slim]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 1
    steps:
      - name: Require all Action platforms to pass
        env: { RESULT: "${{ needs.action.result }}", SLIM_RESULT: "${{ needs.action-slim.result }}" }
        run: |
          if [[ "${RESULT}" == skipped && "${SLIM_RESULT}" == skipped ]]; then
            exit 0
          fi
          test "${RESULT}" = success && test "${SLIM_RESULT}" = success

name: Nightly container
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [master]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: { contents: read }

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Test and publish nightly CLI image
    if: >-
      github.repository == 'kjanat/actionlint' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master') ||
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' && github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == 'master' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency: { group: docker-nightly, cancel-in-progress: false, queue: max }
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions: { contents: read, actions: read, packages: write }
    env:
      SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { ref: "${{ env.SOURCE_SHA }}", fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false }
      - name: Require successful master CI for this commit
        env: { GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}" }
        run: |
          checked_out="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          test "${checked_out}" = "${SOURCE_SHA}"
          passed="$(gh api --method GET "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs" \
            -f head_sha="${SOURCE_SHA}" -f branch=master -f event=push -f status=success \
            --jq '.workflow_runs | length > 0')"
          if [[ "${passed}" != true ]]; then
            echo "::error::No successful push CI exists for ${SOURCE_SHA} on master."
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Derive image metadata
        id: metadata
        run: |
          version="$(git describe --tags --long --abbrev=12 --always --match 'v[0-9]*.[0-9]*.[0-9]*')"
          # Keep the version safe for Docker tags and the Go linker argument.
          [[ "${version}" =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9_][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*$ && ${#version} -le 110 ]]
          created="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
          {
            echo "version=${version}"
            echo "created=${created}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@99012661954931238ded8c8b007157a8430204e1 # v4.4.0
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069 # v4.4.1
      - name: Build both platforms before publishing
        id: build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@c3c9e263c25d99ce0380d002d59b67737d91b0dc # v7.4.0
        with:
          context: .
          target: cli
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
          build-args: ACTIONLINT_VER=${{ steps.metadata.outputs.version }}
          outputs: type=oci,dest=${{ runner.temp }}/nightly.tar
          tags: actionlint:nightly-test
          sbom: true
          provenance: mode=max
          cache-from: type=gha,scope=docker-nightly
          cache-to: type=gha,scope=docker-nightly,mode=max
          labels: |
            org.opencontainers.image.title=actionlint
            org.opencontainers.image.description=Development build from master
            org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}
            org.opencontainers.image.url=https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
            org.opencontainers.image.version=${{ steps.metadata.outputs.version }}
            org.opencontainers.image.revision=${{ env.SOURCE_SHA }}
            org.opencontainers.image.created=${{ steps.metadata.outputs.created }}
            org.opencontainers.image.licenses=MIT
      - name: Test the stored image on both platforms
        env: { VERSION: "${{ steps.metadata.outputs.version }}" }
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends skopeo
          for arch in amd64 arm64; do
            image="actionlint:nightly-test-${arch}"
            skopeo --override-os linux --override-arch "${arch}" copy \
              "oci-archive:${RUNNER_TEMP}/nightly.tar" "docker-daemon:${image}"
            image_version="$(docker run --rm --platform "linux/${arch}" "${image}" --version)"
            grep -F -- "${VERSION}" <<< "${image_version}"
            docker run --rm --platform "linux/${arch}" --entrypoint shellcheck "${image}" --version
            bash distribution/docker/test-docker-ruff.bash "${image}" "linux/${arch}"
            bash distribution/docker/test-docker-plugins.bash "${image}" "linux/${arch}"
            docker run --rm --platform "linux/${arch}" --mount type=bind,source="${PWD}",target=/w,readonly \
              "${image}" testdata/ok/minimal.yaml
            lint_status=0
            docker run --rm --platform "linux/${arch}" --mount type=bind,source="${PWD}",target=/w,readonly \
              "${image}" testdata/err/one_error.yaml || lint_status=$?
            test "${lint_status}" = 1
          done
      - uses: &DockerLogin docker/login-action@81c6f93d4bc991e510b342a00b419b3bb4efc5c6 # v4.7.0
        with: { registry: ghcr.io, username: "${{ github.repository_owner }}", password: "${{ github.token }}" }
      - uses: *DockerLogin
        with: { username: "${{ github.repository_owner }}", password: "${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}" }
      - name: Publish the tested bytes
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.version }}
          DIGEST: ${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}
        run: |
          [[ "${DIGEST}" =~ ^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]]
          # A delayed CI completion or manual rerun must not roll nightly back.
          remote_ref="$(git ls-remote --exit-code origin refs/heads/master)"
          current="${remote_ref%%[[:space:]]*}"
          if [[ "${current}" != "${SOURCE_SHA}" ]]; then
            echo 'Master advanced while this image was building; publication skipped.'
            exit 0
          fi
          for registry in ghcr.io docker.io; do
            for tag in "sha-${SOURCE_SHA}" "nightly-${VERSION}" nightly; do
              skopeo copy --all --preserve-digests --authfile "${HOME}/.docker/config.json" \
                --digestfile "${RUNNER_TEMP}/published.digest" \
                "oci-archive:${RUNNER_TEMP}/nightly.tar" "docker://${registry}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}:${tag}"
              published_digest="$(cat "${RUNNER_TEMP}/published.digest")"
              test "${published_digest}" = "${DIGEST}"
            done
          done

name: Expression conformance probe
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      group:
        description: Corpus to measure (all takes several minutes)
        type: choice
        default: all
        options: [all, literals, from-json, coercion, typed-inputs, decisions]
permissions: { contents: read }
concurrency:
  group: expression-conformance-probe
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  probe:
    name: Measure expressions on GitHub
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with: { node-version-file: .node-version }
      - name: Capture parser verdicts and runner values
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.EXPR_PROBE_TOKEN }}
          PROBE_GROUP: ${{ inputs.group }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [[ -z "${GH_TOKEN}" ]]; then
            echo '::error::Set EXPR_PROBE_TOKEN with Contents, Workflows and Actions write access to this repository. See docs/expression-behavior.md.'
            exit 1
          fi
          args=(run --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --output ".cache/expression-probe/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}")
          if [[ "${PROBE_GROUP}" != all ]]; then args+=(--group "${PROBE_GROUP}"); fi
          node internal/expression/probe/probe.ts "${args[@]}"
      - name: Finish cleanup after interruption
        if: ${{ always() }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.EXPR_PROBE_TOKEN }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          output=".cache/expression-probe/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          if [[ -f "${output}/refs.json" ]]; then
            node internal/expression/probe/probe.ts cleanup --output "${output}"
          fi
      - name: Publish measurement summary
        if: ${{ always() }}
        shell: bash
        run: |

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: "Release tag (vX.Y.Z) the major tag should follow"
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: read

  group: actionlint-release
  cancel-in-progress: false
  queue: max

jobs:
  move:
    name: Move major tag
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { fetch-depth: 0 }
      - name: Validate and move major tag
        env: { TAG: "${{ inputs.tag }}", GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}" }
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "${TAG}" =~ ^v(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$ ]]
          git fetch --force --tags origin
          sha="$(git rev-parse "refs/tags/${TAG}^{commit}")"
          object="$(git rev-parse "refs/tags/${TAG}")"
          type="$(git cat-file -t "${object}")"
          test "${type}" = tag
          annotation="$(git cat-file -p "${object}")"
          grep -q -- '-----BEGIN PGP SIGNATURE-----' <<< "${annotation}"
          verified="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/tags/${object}" --jq '.verification.verified')"
          test "${verified}" = true
          release="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/tags/${TAG}")"
          jq -e --arg tag "${TAG}" '.tag_name == $tag and .draft == false and .prerelease == false' <<< "${release}" >/dev/null
          node tools/release/release-tag-recovery.mjs "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" "${TAG}" "${sha}"
          git cat-file -e "${sha}:action.mjs"
          git cat-file -e "${sha}:SHA256SUMS"
          major="${TAG%%.*}"
          latest="$(git tag --list "${major}.*.*" --sort=-version:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -n1)"
          test "${TAG}" = "${latest}"
          git push --force origin "${sha}:refs/tags/${major}"

name: npm release
run-name: ${{ format('npm {0} {1}', case(inputs.dry-run, 'dry-run', 'publish'), inputs.tag) }}
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      tag: { description: Release tag to publish, required: true, type: string }
      dist-tag: { description: npm dist-tag; auto selects next for prereleases and latest otherwise, default: auto, type: string }
      dry-run: { description: Build and smoke-test without publishing, default: false, type: boolean }
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag: { description: "Release tag to publish (e.g. v2.0.0)", required: true, type: string }
      dist-tag:
        description: "npm dist-tag; auto picks next for a prerelease, otherwise latest"
        required: false
        type: choice
        options: [auto, latest, next]
        default: auto
      dry-run: { description: Build and smoke-test the packages but do not publish, required: true, default: false, type: boolean }

permissions: { contents: read }

# Never cancel a publish in flight: a half-published set would leave the facade
# pointing at platform packages that do not exist.
concurrency:
  group: "npm-release-${{ inputs.tag }}"
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  REGISTRY: https://registry.npmjs.org/
  RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
  DRY_RUN: ${{ inputs.dry-run || 'false' }}

jobs:
  build:
    name: build and smoke-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: { contents: read, actions: read }
    outputs:
      dist-tag: ${{ steps.dist.outputs.tag }}
      platforms: ${{ steps.pack.outputs.platforms }}
      node: ${{ steps.node.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { ref: "${{ case(inputs.dry-run, github.sha, format('refs/tags/{0}', env.RELEASE_TAG)) }}", persist-credentials: false }
      # Manual recovery requires verified release bytes even if a later publishing job failed.
      - name: Verify release before manual publishing
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && contains(github.workflow_ref, '/.github/workflows/npm-release.yml@') && !inputs.dry-run }}
        env: { GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}" }
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          published="$(gh release view --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --json isDraft,publishedAt \
            --jq '(.isDraft == false) and (.publishedAt != null)' -- "${RELEASE_TAG}")"
          if [[ "${published}" != true ]]; then
            echo '::error::Manual npm publishing requires a published GitHub release.'
            exit 1
          fi
          commit="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          runs="$(gh api --method GET "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/workflows/release.yml/runs" \
            --field event=release --field status=completed --field "head_sha=${commit}" --field per_page=100 --paginate \
            --jq '.workflow_runs[] | select(.status == "completed" and .head_branch == env.RELEASE_TAG) | .id')"
          verified=''
          while IFS= read -r run_id; do
            [[ -n "${run_id}" ]] || continue
            jobs="$(gh api --method GET "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${run_id}/jobs" \
              --field filter=latest --field per_page=100 --paginate \
              --jq '.jobs[] | select(.name == "Verify published candidate" and .status == "completed" and .conclusion == "success") | .id')"
            if [[ -n "${jobs}" ]]; then
              verified="${run_id}"
              break
            fi
          done <<< "${runs}"
          if [[ -z "${verified}" ]]; then
            echo '::error::The selected tag and commit need a completed Release run with successful candidate verification before manual npm publishing.'
            exit 1
          fi
      - parallel:
          - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7
            with: { go-version-file: go.mod }
          - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
            with: { node-version-file: .node-version, registry-url: "${{ env.REGISTRY }}" }

      # The publish jobs check out nothing, so .node-version cannot reach them.
      # Passing the version this job resolved keeps one source of truth.
      - name: Report the Node version
        id: node
        run: version="$(node --version)";
          echo "version=${version#v}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      # Downloads every release archive, verifies each against the release's own
      # checksums manifest, and lays out one package per platform plus the facade.
      - name: Build the publish tree
        uses: $/.github/actions/npm-packages
        with: { version: "${{ env.RELEASE_TAG }}" }

      - name: Derive the dist-tag
        id: dist
        env: { REQUESTED: "${{ inputs.dist-tag || 'auto' }}" }
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ -n "${REQUESTED}" && "${REQUESTED}" != 'auto' ]]; then
            tag="${REQUESTED}"
          elif [[ "${RELEASE_TAG#v}" == *-* ]]; then
            # A semver prerelease must never become the default install.
            tag=next
          else
            tag=latest
          fi
          echo "tag=${tag}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          echo "publishing with dist-tag ${tag}"

      # Packing here makes the smoke-tested bytes the published bytes, and
      # renames each tarball to its target for the publish matrix.
      - name: Pack the tarballs
        id: pack
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          shopt -s nullglob
          out=distribution/npm/tarballs
          mkdir -p "${out}"
          for dir in distribution/npm/dist/*/; do
            pkg="$(basename "${dir}")"
            # Packed into an empty directory and taken by glob. For a scoped
            # package, the name npm reports has not always matched the file.
            staging="$(mktemp -d)"
            npm pack "./${dir}" --pack-destination "${staging}"
            packed=("${staging}"/*.tgz)
            if [[ "${#packed[@]}" -ne 1 ]]; then
              echo "::error::npm pack wrote ${#packed[@]} tarballs for ${pkg}, expected 1"
              exit 1
            fi
            mv "${packed[0]}" "${out}/${pkg}.tgz"
            echo "packed ${pkg}.tgz"
          done
          platforms="$(jq -c '[.targets[].pkg]' distribution/npm/targets.json)"
          echo "platforms=${platforms}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      # Exercises the launcher against a real binary before any publish, and
      # unpacks the tarballs: a file missing from one fails here.
      - name: Smoke-test the packed tarballs
        env: { VERSION: "${{ env.RELEASE_TAG }}" }
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version="${VERSION#v}"
          smoke="$(mktemp -d)"
          # Before the packages are laid down. npm prunes what it considers
          # extraneous from the prefix it installs into.
          npm install --prefix "${smoke}" --no-save --no-audit --no-fund ansispeck
          modules="${smoke}/node_modules"
          facade="${modules}/$(jq -r .facade distribution/npm/targets.json)"
          scope="${modules}/$(jq -r .platformScope distribution/npm/targets.json)"
          unpack() {
            local tarball="$1" dest="$2"
            mkdir -p "${dest}"
            tar -xzf "${tarball}" -C "${dest}" --strip-components=1
            local name
            name="$(jq -r .name "${dest}/package.json")"
            (cd "${smoke}" && node -e 'require(process.argv[1] + "/package.json")' "${name}")
          }
          unpack distribution/npm/tarballs/facade.tgz "${facade}"
          for pkg in $(jq -r '.targets[].pkg' distribution/npm/targets.json); do
            unpack "distribution/npm/tarballs/${pkg}.tgz" "${scope}/actionlint-${pkg}"
          done
          cmp actionlint.schema.json "${facade}/actionlint.schema.json"
          (cd "${smoke}" && node -e 'require("@kjanat/actionlint/schema")')
          got="$(node "${facade}/bin/actionlint.mjs" -version | head -1)"
          echo "launcher reported: ${got}"
          case "${got}" in
          *"${version}") ;;
          *)
            echo "::error::the launcher reported '${got}', expected it to end with ${version}"
            exit 1
            ;;
          esac
          # Declared in the facade's manifest, so it has to be in the tarball;
          # a missing file leaves a dangling "man" entry.
          if [[ ! -s "${facade}/man/actionlint.1" ]]; then
            echo "::error::the facade tarball carries no man/actionlint.1"
            exit 1
          fi
          bash tools/release/check-packaged-cli.bash node "${facade}/bin/actionlint.mjs"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with: { name: npm-tarballs, path: distribution/npm/tarballs, retention-days: 7 }

  # Leaves first: the facade pins them exactly. One job per package, each with
  # its own deployment, from the environment named in its npm trusted publisher.
  platforms:
    name: publish ${{ matrix.pkg }}
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: { contents: read, id-token: write }
    environment:
      name: npm-actionlint
      url: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.url }}
    env:
      # Set per job: an environment's variables only resolve inside the job
      # deploying to it. PROVENANCE=false opts out; a dry run forces it off.
      NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: ${{ (inputs.dry-run && 'false') || vars.PROVENANCE || 'true' }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        pkg: ${{ fromJSON(needs.build.outputs.platforms) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with: { node-version: "${{ needs.build.outputs.node }}", registry-url: "${{ env.REGISTRY }}" }
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with: { name: npm-tarballs, path: tarballs }
      - uses: $/.github/actions/npm-publish
        id: publish
        with:
          tarball: tarballs/${{ matrix.pkg }}.tgz
          dist-tag: "${{ needs.build.outputs.dist-tag }}"
          dry-run: "${{ env.DRY_RUN }}"

  facade:
    name: publish the facade
    needs: [build, platforms]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: { contents: read, id-token: write }
    environment:
      name: npm
      url: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.url }}
    env:
      NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE: ${{ (inputs.dry-run && 'false') || vars.PROVENANCE || 'true' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with: { node-version: "${{ needs.build.outputs.node }}", registry-url: "${{ env.REGISTRY }}" }
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with: { name: npm-tarballs, path: tarballs }
      - uses: $/.github/actions/npm-publish
        id: publish
        with:
          tarball: tarballs/facade.tgz
          dist-tag: "${{ needs.build.outputs.dist-tag }}"
          dry-run: "${{ env.DRY_RUN }}"

          echo "version=${RELEASE_TAG#v}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - uses: &Checkout actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: *Checkout
        if: &Manual ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && contains(github.workflow_ref, '/.github/workflows/pypi-release.yml@') && !inputs.dry-run }}
        with: { ref: "refs/tags/${{ inputs.tag }}", path: .release-tag, fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with: { node-version-file: .node-version, package-manager-cache: false }
      - name: Verify release before manual publishing
        if: *Manual
        working-directory: .release-tag
        env: { GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}" }
        run: |
          published="$(gh release view --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --json isDraft,publishedAt \
            --jq '(.isDraft == false) and (.publishedAt != null)' -- "${RELEASE_TAG}")"
          if [[ "${published}" != true ]]; then
            echo '::error::Manual PyPI publishing requires a published GitHub release.'
            exit 1
          fi
          object="$(git rev-parse "refs/tags/${RELEASE_TAG}")"
          object_type="$(git cat-file -t "${object}")"
          test "${object_type}" = tag
          tag_object="$(git cat-file -p "${object}")"
          grep -q -- '-----BEGIN PGP SIGNATURE-----' <<< "${tag_object}"
          verified="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/tags/${object}" --jq '.verification.verified')"
          test "${verified}" = true
          tag_commit="$(git rev-parse "refs/tags/${RELEASE_TAG}^{commit}")"
          head_commit="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          test "${tag_commit}" = "${head_commit}"
      - name: Detect whether the release carries wheels
        id: source
        env: { GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}" }
        run: |
          names="$(gh release view "${RELEASE_TAG}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --json assets --jq '.assets[].name')"
          wheels=false
          if grep -q '\.whl$' <<< "${names}"; then wheels=true; fi
          echo "wheels=${wheels}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          echo "${RELEASE_TAG} carries wheels: ${wheels}"

      - name: Verify the released wheels against the release candidate manifest
        if: steps.source.outputs.wheels == 'true'
        env: { GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}" }
        run: |
          assets="${RUNNER_TEMP}/candidate-assets"
          gh release download "${RELEASE_TAG}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --dir "${assets}"
          manifest_tag="$(jq -r .tag "${assets}/release-candidate.json")"
          test "${manifest_tag}" = "${RELEASE_TAG}"
          manifest_commit="$(jq -r .candidate "${assets}/release-candidate.json")"
          tag_commit="$(git rev-parse "refs/tags/${RELEASE_TAG}^{commit}")"
          test "${manifest_commit}" = "${tag_commit}"
          node tools/release/release-candidate.mjs verify --directory "${assets}"
          mkdir -p distribution/pypi/dist
          cp -- "${assets}"/*.whl distribution/pypi/dist/
      - name: Verify the build provenance of every released wheel
        if: steps.source.outputs.wheels == 'true'
        env: { GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}" }
        run: |
          for wheel in distribution/pypi/dist/*.whl; do
            gh attestation verify --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" "${wheel}"
          done
      - uses: $/.github/actions/pypi-wheels
        if: steps.source.outputs.wheels == 'true'
        with: { version: "${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}", out-dir: "${{ github.workspace }}/distribution/pypi/dist", smoke: manylinux_2_17_x86_64 }

      - name: Download the release archives and check them against the release checksums
        if: steps.source.outputs.wheels == 'false'
        env: { GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}", VERSION: "${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}" }
        run: |
          gh release download "${RELEASE_TAG}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-assets" \
            --pattern "actionlint_${VERSION}_*"
          cd "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-assets"
          sha256sum --check --ignore-missing --strict "actionlint_${VERSION}_checksums.txt"
      - name: Verify the build provenance of every archive
        if: steps.source.outputs.wheels == 'false'
        env: { GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}", VERSION: "${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}" }
        run: |
          for archive in "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-assets/actionlint_${VERSION}_"*.{tar.gz,zip}; do
            gh attestation verify --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" "${archive}"
          done
      - name: Verify the release candidate manifest when the release has one
        if: ${{ steps.source.outputs.wheels == 'false' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && contains(github.workflow_ref, '/.github/workflows/pypi-release.yml@') && !inputs.dry-run }}
        working-directory: .release-tag
        env: { GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}" }
        run: |
          names="$(gh release view "${RELEASE_TAG}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --json assets --jq '.assets[].name')"
          if ! grep -qx release-candidate.json <<< "${names}"; then
            echo "::notice::${RELEASE_TAG} predates the release candidate pipeline and has no release-candidate.json."
            exit 0
          fi
          gh release download "${RELEASE_TAG}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/candidate-assets"
          node tools/release/release-candidate.mjs verify --directory "${RUNNER_TEMP}/candidate-assets"
      - uses: $/.github/actions/pypi-wheels
        if: steps.source.outputs.wheels == 'false'
        with:
          version: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
          assets-dir: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets
          out-dir: ${{ github.workspace }}/distribution/pypi/dist
          smoke: manylinux_2_17_x86_64

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with: { name: pypi-wheels, path: distribution/pypi/dist/*.whl, if-no-files-found: error, retention-days: 7 }

  publish:
    name: Publish to PyPI
    needs: build
    if: ${{ !inputs.dry-run }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions: { contents: read, id-token: write }
    environment:
      name: pypi
      url: https://pypi.org/project/actionlint-kjanat/${{ needs.build.outputs.version }}/
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with: { name: pypi-wheels, path: dist }
      - uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@7245906fb61fa33a13554f9d5fb856fe61758086 # v1.14.3
        with: { packages-dir: dist, skip-existing: true }

name: Release notes
on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths: [docs/releases/v*.md]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: { contents: read }
defaults: { run: { shell: "bash --noprofile --norc -eo pipefail {0}" } }

jobs:
  sync:
    name: Copy docs/releases to the GitHub releases
    if: github.repository == 'kjanat/actionlint' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    concurrency: { group: release-notes, cancel-in-progress: false, queue: max }
    permissions: { contents: write }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7
        with: { go-version-file: go.mod }
      - name: Update every release whose notes file changed
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          BEFORE: ${{ github.event.before }}
        run: |
          if [[ "${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME}" == push && "${BEFORE}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ && "${BEFORE}" != 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 ]]; then
            deleted="$(git diff --name-only --no-renames --diff-filter=D "${BEFORE}" "${GITHUB_SHA}" -- 'docs/releases/v*.md')"
            if [[ -n "${deleted}" ]]; then
              echo "::error::Release notes files were deleted; their releases keep a body without a source: ${deleted//$'\n'/, }"
              exit 1
            fi
            changed="$(git diff --name-only --no-renames --diff-filter=AM "${BEFORE}" "${GITHUB_SHA}" -- 'docs/releases/v*.md')"
          else
            changed="$(git ls-files -- 'docs/releases/v*.md')"
          fi
          if [[ -z "${changed}" ]]; then
            echo 'No release notes file changed.'
            exit 0
          fi
          mapfile -t files <<< "${changed}"
          tags=()
          for file in "${files[@]}"; do
            tag="$(basename "${file}" .md)"
            [[ "${tag}" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]
            go run ./tools/release/bump-version -notes "${tag}" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/${tag}.md"
            tags+=("${tag}")
          done
          for tag in "${tags[@]}"; do
            if lookup="$(gh release view "${tag}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --json tagName --jq .tagName 2>&1)"; then
              gh release edit "${tag}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --notes-file "${RUNNER_TEMP}/${tag}.md"
              echo "${tag}: notes updated from docs/releases/${tag}.md"
            elif [[ "${lookup}" == *"release not found"* ]]; then
              echo "::notice file=docs/releases/${tag}.md::No release ${tag} exists yet; the file publishes with it."
            else
              echo "${lookup}" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          done
